chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi reported to me, saying: Ali ibn Abdillah ibn Asad al-Isfahani narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us, saying: al-Qannad narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib who said: I heard Yahya ibn Umm al-Tawil saying: I heard the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), saying:

"There is no verse between the two covers of the Quran except that I know for whom it was revealed and where it was revealed, whether on a plain or upon a mountain. And indeed, within my breast is abundant knowledge. So ask me before you lose me, for if you lose me, you will not find anyone who speaks to you the like of my speech."

key_terms.جوانحي: My ribs/breast, figuratively referring to the heart and mind as the seat of knowledge
key_terms.فسلوني: Ask me — an imperative urging people to seek knowledge
key_terms.لوحي المصحف: The two covers of the Quran (mushaf), referring to the entire Quran

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his knowledge of the Quran?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) declares his comprehensive knowledge of every Quranic verse, including the circumstances, recipients, and locations of revelation. Speaking to his companions in Kufa, he urges them to benefit from his unique knowledge before his passing, emphasizing that no one after him would possess such detailed understanding of the Quran. This statement reflects the Shia belief in the divinely-granted knowledge of the Imams.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi reported to me from ‘Ali ibn Abdillah ibn Asad al-Ishfahani, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from al-Qannad, who reported from ‘Ali ibn Hashim, from his father, from Saeed ibn al-Musayyib who said: I heard Amirul Mu’mineen ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, say:

"There is no verse between the two covers of the Qur’an, except that I know for whom it was revealed and when it was revealed, and whether on a plain, levelled land or upon a mountain. Surely, here in my breast is abundant knowledge! So, put your questions to me before you do not find me among yourselves, for when you have lost me, you will not find anyone uttering the words I utter."
